app.name: kudosity-messaging-3l8g1e
app.label: Kudosity
app.description: Kudosity is a business platform that helps organisations send SMS and MMS messages. Our workflow automation enables businesses to send order updates from e-commerce platforms, automate lead nurture programs, and improve customer engagement.

$parkedComment: Modules kept in the repo but not deployed, so the first Make review only covers channels the test account can run. WhatsApp needs a WhatsApp-enabled sender and RCS an RCS agent sender; the test account has neither yet (SAL-103). Get Sender IDs (V1) is parked because get-sender-ids.json is being replaced (decision 19 Nov 2026). To publish one later, move its entry back into modules and deploy; Make reviews the update.
